payload_opening_bound: The failed ProcessPool execution may have opened up to all seven delayed SIM payloads before the gamma future raised; no result from that attempt is used as authority.
root_cause: The analyzer incorrectly required IA INIT field 15 to equal the sampled source-parent ZA. Field 15 is the transported or daughter ZA and is not a parent-lineage identifier.
correct_lineage_authority: The sampled source parent is assigned only by the strict exact-position cKDTree mapping with the retained nearest-distance, nearest-gap, and distance-ratio gates.
correction: Keep sim_initial_ZA and source_parent_ZA separately; classify and report their relation without rejecting daughter-chain differences. No position-lineage tolerance was relaxed.
recovery_scan_policy: A clean authoritative rerun is necessary because the failed work directory was intentionally deleted. Each of seven delayed SIMs will be scanned exactly once in the successful execution; this recovery audit preserves the earlier nonpublished access.
